description:
The prompts where competitors' URLs were cited in the site's own audit history (MCP runs on its domain included) but the site's weren't — one competitor, or all at once. Asks no engine.

Billing: 5¢ per call, one competitor or all. Not billed when the site or competitor_domain is rejected, the scan fails, or nothing was answered in the window (total_prompts_scanned 0).

When to call: 'what is <competitor> cited on that we're not', 'who beats us in AI answers' across the site's audits (omit competitor_domain for all, one call). One audit: get_audit (free); prompts no audit asked: explore_llm_mentions.

Returns { rows: [{prompt, competitor_url (one competitor) or winning_urls + competitors_cited (all), engines_competitor_cited_on, last_cited_at, user_brand_mentioned, leverage, winnable, flags?}], competitors? (all: [{competitor_domain, prompts_won, high_leverage, pure_loss, engines}]), leverage_legend, total_prompts_scanned, window_days, charged_cents }. leverage: high_leverage = brand named but not URL-cited (closest gap), pure_loss = not named either. winnable false (flags dated / other_brands_head_to_head): usually not worth a fix. A competitor not on the site: competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains.

competitor_domain.description: One of the site's competitor_domains (see list_sites). Omit to analyze every competitor on the site in one 5¢ run.

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

window_days.description: Days of audit history to scan, 7–365. Default 30.

name: mine_competitor_prompts
title: Find prompts where competitors are winning citations and you're not
